claims.title: Relational individuation
claims.summary: Genuine individuals may be dynamically maintained, relatively autonomous patterns constituted through relations rather than intrinsically independent substances.

claims.title: Novelty and emergence
claims.summary: Novel patterns of organization may become causally significant conditions for later processes; this does not, by itself, establish strong emergence.

claims.title: Selfhood as a multi-dimensional research question
claims.summary: AI selfhood should be analyzed along distinct dimensions of continuity, agency, self-modeling, governance, recognition, and possible experience without presupposing consciousness.
